captions.text: US midterms: would you know / a political ad was / [made with AI]?
captions.plain: US midterms: would you know a political ad was made with AI?

captions.text: By mid-October: [$137 million] / spent airing about 220 ads / made at least partly with AI.
captions.plain: By mid-October: $137 million spent airing about 220 ads made at least partly with AI.

captions.text: Only about [3 in 10] / carried a label saying / AI was used.
captions.plain: Only about 3 in 10 carried a label saying AI was used.

captions.text: About 30 states require / some AI disclosure. There is / [no federal rule].
captions.plain: About 30 states require some AI disclosure. There is no federal rule.

captions.text: Ten AI ads. / About three of them / [said so].
captions.plain: Ten AI ads. About three of them said so.
